description:
FILED s467 (Fable, 2026-09-04) from the README refresh's board re-run (main bc9aa4a, gen v2-611): baselines/cpan-board14-s467.tsv vs the previous snapshot baselines/cpan-board14-s378.tsv (2026-08-23, main 23e3005).

Totals moved UP (70 PASS / 64 PARTIAL / 49 FAIL, 2053 ok / 483 not-ok  ->  78 / 54 / 51, 2140 ok / 342 not-ok), but nine files moved DOWN and are unattributed (the board is not a gate; nothing bisected):

  Role-Tiny        role-long-package-name.t   PASS 7/0     -> FAIL 0/0
  Try-Tiny         when.t                     PASS 1/0     -> FAIL 0/0     (given/when: expected under #1037's statement-level refusal? -- verify; given_when.t PARTIAL 1/1 -> FAIL 0/0 likewise)
  Text-Balanced    05_extmul.t                PARTIAL 63/33 -> FAIL 0/0
  Scalar-List-Utils dualvar.t                 PARTIAL 14/2  -> FAIL 0/0
  Scalar-List-Utils max.t / min.t / product.t PASS 5/0, 5/0, 12/0 -> PARTIAL 5/2, 5/2, 12/1   (product.t row 13 "overload": got 6 expected 8 -- an overload change, #972 family?)
  Capture-Tiny     09-preserve-exit-code.t, 17-pass-results.t, 19-relayering.t, 25-cap-fork.t   PARTIAL -> FAIL 0/0
  Algorithm-Diff   oo.t                       PASS 59/0    -> PARTIAL 102/20   (43 more rows RUN, 20 of them fail -- a file that used to stop early)
  Data-Dump        dump.t                     PASS 31/0    -> PARTIAL 34/2
  Class-Method-Modifiers 140-lvalue.t         PARTIAL 6/3  -> 2/7

Moved UP (for the record): Sort-Versions versions.t 65/31 -> 96/0 (#239 family closed), Text-Balanced 02/03/04/08 -> PASS and 06/07/09 large gains (#237), Role-Tiny subclass.t + role-basic-composition.t -> PASS, Data-Dump quote.t FAIL -> PASS 16/0, three *-report-prereqs.t FAIL 0/0 -> PASS 1/0, Class-Inspector functions 19 -> 24.

Job: for each DOWN file, run tools/run-dist-t.pl on it alone against a 23e3005 worktree and HEAD, read the first failing row, attribute to a round (the s378 -> s467 range is rounds 4-23), file or fix.  Some are expected (a given/when file under the statement-level refusal; a file whose skip branch now runs honestly) -- those get a cause line in the snapshot's header, not a fix.  The board's oracle rules: docs/cpan-module-log.md + memory project_cpan_board_state (always run real perl beside it; never -I<dist>/lib for Scalar-List-Utils).


=== SCHEDULED (s474b, Fable, 2026-09-07) ===
USER: "Sounds good" -- #1061 is the next FILLER after s473t3 (queue row 0e in docs/plan-post-s473.md); brief ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s473/s1061/prompt.md.  It BLOCKS #1502 (the board cause column), which blocks #1504 (widening).  Main has moved past s467 (rounds 24-29 + s473t1/t2), so the brief starts with a FRESH snapshot on the current main and attributes any NEW movers too.


=== DONE (s1061) ===
Opus agent, 2026-09-07, worktree agent-ae5543b3fb4250faa.  All nine down-movers
have a COMMIT.  Two of them were compiler bugs and are FIXED here; the rest are
explained in the header of `baselines/cpan-board14-s474.tsv` with a task each.

FIRST FINDING -- THE RANGE IN THIS TASK WAS WRONG.  `cpan-board14-s378.tsv` was
MEASURED at `5d941618` (2026-08-09, s378).  `23e30051`, the sha named above, is
only where s440 MOVED the file from `docs/` to `baselines/`.  The real range is
`5d941618..d00bb576` -- 568 commits, not 238 -- and it CONTAINS the announce->DIE
flip `f702da31`, which the shorter range would have hidden behind its own
baseline.  A baseline file's NAME is not its measurement point; `git log --follow`
on the file is.

| file | s378 -> s467 | s474 | commit | round | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Role-Tiny role-long-package-name.t | PASS 7/0 -> FAIL 0/0 | FAIL 0/0 | `e79f0a63` | s407a (#362) | FILED #1510 -- a correct fix (code refs numify to their address) unmasked a deferred non-support: `%{"Pkg::"}` lists only SUBS |
| Try-Tiny given_when.t | PARTIAL 1/1 -> FAIL 0/0 | FAIL 0/0 | `048b6871` | s415b (#371 Track A) | EXPECTED -- the ruled given/when refusal; the lost `ok` was undef==undef |
| Capture-Tiny 09/17/19/25 | PARTIAL -> FAIL 0/0 | FAIL 0/0 | `f702da31` | s435 (THE FLIP) | FILED #1509 -- ONE gap: Capture::Tiny installs its `(&;@)` prototypes from a STRING EVAL, so `capture { â¦ }` is not a block-form call and drops |
| Scalar-List-Utils dualvar.t | PARTIAL 14/2 -> FAIL 0/0 | FAIL 0/0 | `b95ad912` | s436 (phase model) | FIXED #1505 (the file READS again) + FILED #1506 (`import constant HAVE_THREADS => 0`) |
| Scalar-List-Utils max.t | PASS 5/0 -> PARTIAL 5/2 | PARTIAL 8/2 | `b95ad912` then `bfa170d9` | s436, s461ar | MORE COVERAGE + FILED #1507; the second transition FIXED by #1508 |
| Scalar-List-Utils min.t | PASS 5/0 -> PARTIAL 5/2 | PARTIAL 20/2 | `b95ad912` | s436 | same |
| Scalar-List-Utils product.t | PASS 12/0 -> PARTIAL 12/1 | PARTIAL 23/4 | `b95ad912` | s436 | same; the three NEW s474 failures are #1525 |
| Algorithm-Diff oo.t | PASS 59/0 -> PARTIAL 102/20 | PARTIAL 102/20 | `b1847eb7` | s411d (Phase A4) | MORE COVERAGE (43 more rows RUN); FILED #1511 |
| Data-Dump dump.t | PASS 31/0 -> PARTIAL 34/2 | PARTIAL 34/2 | `a46aa3f0` | s404f (#354+#351) | MORE COVERAGE (3 more statements survive); FILED #1511 |
| Class-Method-Modifiers 140-lvalue.t | PARTIAL 6/3 -> PARTIAL 2/7 | PARTIAL 2/7 | `551202b3` | s464a (#964) | EXPECTED -- `:lvalue` is USER-deferred (#930); the lost rows passed on the aliasing bug #964 removed |
| Text-Balanced 05_extmul.t | PARTIAL 63/33 -> FAIL 0/0 rc124 | FAIL 0/0 rc124 | NOT BISECTED | -- | FILED #1512 with the reason: the verdict is not stable on a shared box (two runs of `d00bb576` gave 16/14 and 0/0) and a step costs 150-600 s |

Try-Tiny `when.t` (also listed above) needed no work: it came BACK to PASS at
`0cbe7831` (s466bc, #1037) and the s467 header already says so.

FIXED HERE
 * #1505 `e2257d93` -- `import Foo::Bar;` emitted the BARE designator
   `:Foo::Bar`, not a CL token ("too many colons"), so the reader stopped and
   every later form in the emitted file was lost.  One line: route through
   `Pl::Parser::_cl_pkg_designator`, the single source of truth for that
   spelling.  Guards Pl/t/misc-fixes-02.t 127 -> 129.
 * #1508 `bd01f012` -- `$ref->{k} =~ s///` / `=~ tr///` wrote to a VALUE: the
   `=~` write-target gate asked `_is_elem_arg`, whose set is the NAMED-container
   element kinds only, so the DEREF pair never got lvalue_context.  #960 fixed
   exactly this omission at `pos()` -- the four-kind table is a FAMILY and a scan
   for a third site is owed.  Since `bfa170d9` (#911) that silent no-op became
   perl's "Modification of a read-only value attempted", and core Math::BigInt
   writes `$x->{sign} =~ tr/+-/-+/` six times.  Guards misc-fixes-02.t 129 -> 131.
   Generation v2-1010; the three artifacts regenerated.

THE FRESH SNAPSHOT.  A board taken on main `dfa65afa` BEFORE either fix was
byte-identical to `cpan-board14-s467.tsv` -- zero movers across rounds 24-29,
s473t1/t2 and BZ -- so the nine were the whole job.  The board taken on the
FINAL tree moved exactly FOUR rows, all Scalar-List-Utils and all #1508's doing
(the files reach their Math::BigInt section): max 5/2 -> 8/2, min 5/2 -> 20/2,
product 12/1 -> 23/4, sum PASS 8/0 -> PARTIAL 15/3.  `sum.t`'s label move is not
a regression -- it used to die after 8 of its 18 planned rows, and 8/0 reads
PASS under the "zero not-ok" rule.  Blessed as `baselines/cpan-board14-s474.tsv`
(183 rows, 79 PASS / 54 PARTIAL / 50 FAIL, 2190 ok / 346 not-ok) with a header
that names all four.

TASKS FILED: #1506, #1507, #1509, #1510, #1511, #1512 (from the bisects) and
#1525 (from the s474 delta -- `scalar(EXPR)` on a HASH REFERENCE returns the
raw hash table, so an overloaded object loses its `""` handler).
NOTE FOR #1502/#1504: a drop in a BOARD dist's `t/` file is counted NOWHERE --
the drop census's cpan population is `cpan-tests/modules/**/t/**`, and the
14-dist board's own `t/` files are in no population at all, so Capture-Tiny's
seven drops have been invisible to every counter.  The board also has no
registered-timeout mechanism (the perl-suite runner has
`baselines/perl-suite-timeouts.tsv`), which is why 05_extmul.t reads FAIL 0/0.
